title: Coffee orbit — approved one-hand start and close downward catch

assistant_visual_review.method: 25 sampled overview frames, 13 approach/release samples, nine catch-contact samples, full video decode and numeric audio checks.
observations: Opening visibly follows approved v06: one foreground hand, man farther ahead on the left, clear cafe sidewalk.
Riley approaches without first running past him. He remains nearby for the rescue.
Cup separates around 2.3s and follows a mainly downward path toward the ground; no large upward floating move like v02 is evident in the sampled sequence.
Third-person low view shows a nearby mug, crouched reach and visible low catch around 6.5–6.75s, followed by handback around 7.4–8.4s.
Departure around 8.8–10s shows real forward displacement and a cyan trail.
limitations: She looks toward the man while he is still holding the cup; TPP begins about 2.1s before release. The requested discovery of an already-falling mug in FPP is missing.
Camera uses an over-shoulder angle and then a low-side cut around 3s; the catch remains mainly in that view with limited travel. A broad continuous circular orbit is not achieved.

Riley wardrobe/identity drift: longer asymmetric gold dress and gold heeled sandals replace approved mini-dress/black-gold boots; facial cyberware differs. Fixed-start mode cannot also take the approved identity images.
Mug timing lingers, coffee drains out and the exact grip/empty-cup continuity require playback judgment. Low catch is visible but not claimed physically exact.
Opening aims increasingly toward the patron; this is not a fully convincing casual passing glance.
Native audio has numeric checks only; no independent listening, speech-absence guarantee or final sound mix approval.
assistant_visual_review.assistant_verdict: Approach and low downward rescue improved; first-person airborne discovery, circular camera and approved wardrobe are not achieved. Not ready to lock.

user_feedback.summary: Opening cup must be out of frame. Fast FPP with blurred sides, sudden slow motion and side glance, switch to TPP with readable sideways eye movement, circular camera during a quick nearby catch. Visible release repeatedly reads intentional.
user_feedback.scope: Revised choreography and reference requirements; existing outputs are not accepted by this feedback.
